I will keep most of my land in the wheat-maize rotation because that is the system I know best, it fits my well irrigation, and it gives me stable grain output for the household and cash. I will keep a smaller part in chrysanthemum because it can bring better income, but it needs more care, so I will not expand it too much. For wheat and maize, I will use better seed, moderate fertilizer, and enough irrigation to protect yield without overspending. For chrysanthemum, I will put more effort into field care, fertilizer, water, and plant protection because its value is higher and quality matters. I will use rotary tillage because it saves labor and matches my equipment and age better than heavier ploughing.
